summary: "I will be a designer in this city." The dream journey of the cat girl Mocha begins. A puzzle and story game that you can take a closer look at and solve.
description:
■ Puzzle
Look at the picture of the hint. Find the right place for the item.
When you find it, place the item just like the picture.
A cute animal guest is coming.

■ Stage like four picture books
Seiko Festival, Forest Cafe, Castle Garden, Star Bakery

■ Play time
One stage is cleared in about 15 minutes. It's a small game with 4 stages.

■ Story
Positive success story of a girl who lives positively

-to you------------------------------

This game features lots of animals and nice food and scenery. I drew all the pictures with a pencil. I draw with all my heart and gentleness in every corner of the world. When you play, your feelings will calm down. I would be happy if you could feel relieved.

-From the author ------------------------------
